method: Exact-path union before fuzzy search; NFKD casefold, accent removal, unordered tokens, bidirectional explicit dotted-initial punctuation compaction; bounded Levenshtein with conservative character-count pruning and equal-boundary trimming only without a score-1 exact hit
limits: Ordinary exact and explicit dotted-initial candidates are combined before considering fuzzy matches. Different lists and records remain separate name alerts, never inferred identical entities.

Equal-similarity results retain source precedence, then prefer primary names, explicitly strong aliases, ungraded aliases, and explicitly weak aliases within each list. This is record presentation, not identity adjudication or alias reclassification.
Name similarity is not identity confirmation.
Non-SDN restrictions differ from SDN asset blocking.
UN and Australian lists are not checked; UK, Canadian and EU coverage is entities only.

EU names are literal XML fields corroborated by CSV entry and name IDs, exact or token-order only; individual records are excluded. The EU consolidated list is administrative; adopted Official Journal texts are authoritative.
Canadian aliases are limited to PDF-corroborated single fields, exact or token-order only; compound alias fields and ships are not checked. Its consolidated list is administrative, not law.

BIS Entity List names use literal ITA JSON values corroborated by CSV and the BIS legal table, exact or token-order only. ITA-reported licensing metadata is separate from quoted primary BIS legal-table rows; primary legal text takes precedence where they differ. Export licensing restrictions differ from asset blocking; Entity List parties can include persons and unspecified party types remain null. Military End User List names are literal ITA values corroborated in the primary BIS Supplement 7 table, exact/token-order only. Only explicitly listed subordinate institutions are included; ownership is not inferred. ITA licensing and citation metadata is separately attributed; primary table cells are quoted verbatim, including blanks. BIS DPL coverage is limited to literal primary names with explicit start/expiry dates, Standard denial, notice-only remarks whitelist and primary BIS page/CSV plus ITA JSON/CSV agreement. Date intervals are checked per request in UTC, inclusive; no order time-of-day, suspended terms, identity, aliases or party types are inferred. Other Commerce/State CSL lists are not checked. CSL file dates are HTTP Last-Modified, not individual designation dates.
Ownership-based sanctions and unlisted subsidiaries are not checked.
Additional OFAC formatted names use literal enhanced XML values corroborated in advanced XML, exact or token-order only. No unlisted transliteration or phonetic expansion is guessed.
Dotted-initial compaction is punctuation normalization, not a new published alias or identity confirmation; a weak published alias remains weak.
